motion_system: marks breathe like shallow pressure changes: lower ridges lift fractionally, pinholes brighten, seams open by a hair, edge panels tilt with no visible chrome
color_drift: dirty ivory and tobacco-beige migrate into pale green, blue-violet, graphite, and tiny saturated pixel-pollen sparks
glow_behavior: mostly matte; cool glints only at pinholes, enamel flecks, and folded edge repairs
